narrative.details: Now that you can disguise yourself as a ruling member of the Twilight Council, I am certain Bor Wildmane will want to speak with you.  Go see him, and prepare yourself for a very difficult mission...
narrative.objectives: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
narrative.offerRewardText: Yes, that's right, adventurer. I have a very tough task ahead...
